title: Constant-factor scaling of randomized time
statement: For every natural number $a$ and time bound $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, every language decidable with bounded error in time bounded by a constant multiple of $n \mapsto aT(n)$ is decidable with bounded error in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$.
